<script id="ledajans-logo-swap">
(function () {
  var NEW = 'https://ledajans.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/ledajans-logo.webp';
  var re = /LedajansLogo|ledajans-logo|leadajans-logo/i;
  function swap(root) {
    (root || document).querySelectorAll("img").forEach(function (img) {
      var s = img.getAttribute("src") || "";
      if (img.classList.contains("ledajans-footer-logo") || img.closest(".ledajans-footer")) return;
      if (img.closest(".elementor-element-123bc72 .site-branding-logo, .logo-mm")) return;
      var hit = re.test(s) || img.closest(".gsc-logo");
      if (hit && s !== NEW) { img.setAttribute("src", NEW); img.setAttribute("data-src", NEW); }
    });
  }
  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () { swap(document); });
  } else {
    swap(document);
  }
})();
</script>

<script id="ledajans-logo-places">
(function () {
  var PNG = "https://ledajans.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/" + "LedajansLogo.png";
  var WEB = "https://ledajans.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/ledajans-logo-web.jpg";
  function place() {
    document.querySelectorAll("img.ledajans-footer-logo").forEach(function (img) {
      img.setAttribute("src", PNG);
      img.setAttribute("data-src", PNG);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll(".elementor-element-123bc72 .site-branding-logo img, .logo-mm img").forEach(function (img) {
      img.setAttribute("src", WEB);
      img.setAttribute("data-src", WEB);
    });
  }
  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () { setTimeout(place, 0); });
  } else {
    setTimeout(place, 0);
  }
})();
</script>
